title: IIP Canonical Envelope
description: The fixed envelope every record crosses a service boundary in (Data Model 1a). One schema for the whole platform, not one per contract: payload is an opaque object here, and its shape is the Contract Registry's business, not this file's. Registered with the Schema Registry as subject 'iip.envelope-value' under BACKWARD compatibility. additionalProperties is deliberately left open -- BACKWARD exists so an adapter keeps working when the source service ships an envelope change first, and a closed schema would break precisely that case, on the consumer side, in production.

recordId.description: Unique per event, not per entity. Every adapter's idempotency key.

contractId.description: Which contract this record conforms to. Same character class the Contract Registry enforces on registration, so a contractId that could never be registered can never appear on a topic either.

recordType.description: The event type within the contract, e.g. intern.created. That it is one of the contract's *declared* record types is checked by the source service, which knows the contract; this schema only knows it must be present and non-empty.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version this payload was validated against. Versions start at 1, which is what makes the per-contract compatibility check meaningful.

naturalKey.description: Business identifier, derived per the contract's key strategy. Also the Kafka partition key, so an empty one would silently collapse ordering into round-robin -- hence minLength.

occurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC, set server-side at publish time.

traceId.description: Correlates every event of one logical user action. Nullable and not required until Release 8 wires propagation end-to-end; the field is declared now so the envelope's shape does not change when it does.

payload.description: The per-contract body. Deliberately unconstrained here: constraining it would make this a per-contract schema and put the platform back where Release 3 started.
